title: DeepSeek-V4.1 ROM array (S81, 1,792 pairs, HALF_PHL BF), 1M context, MTP (DSpark, gamma 5)

headline.basis: II = slowest stage busy x (1 + measured handoff 46/11271) + measured hop; verify = AR + 5 II; draft = 3 DSpark blocks + 5 x draft head occupancy x (1 + Markov/lm_head MACs) + fixed draft overhead; tau 4.159 (results/speculative/v41_mtp_acceptance_qualified_20261003/blend_owner6.json blends['owner 6-class equal'].greedy.tau_blend_harmonic (owner 6-class workload blend (adopted 2026-10-05); harmonic, greedy, gamma 5)); 1,792 HALF mapping adds 35 hops once a step
headline.status: measured field + composed MTP rule (wavefront and draft placement not physically qualified)

totals.reproduces: one verify step 1,177,528.1 cycles = 981.273 us; tau 4.159 accepted tokens a step -> 283,127.7 cycles (235.940 us) an accepted token = 4,238.37 tok/s; published 4,238.4 (within rounding)

classes.label: ROM field (q / BF elements, VM, gather, capture, PQ root)
Embed ROM / Engram lookup (HBM-resident tables, design 2026-10-08)

groups.label: Draft head x 5 (LM head + Markov, serial chain)
verify 62 stage hops not placed by the record
verify Stage 58: head die (LM head, argmax)
verify positions 2-6 (wavefront II 27.767 us at L19.ffn.hc_pre .. L20.substage_hop0)
accept / commit + seed of the next step

drill.why: the wavefront: positions 2-6 at the slowest stage's interval

draft full-KP4 FEC delta.note: 4293 cycles (7 board hops x 99 + 36 collectives x 100), spread over the hop / collective operators
